facts.fact: The National Shared Services Centre in Abuja, run by Galaxy Backbone, was commissioned on 20 December 2022 and houses a Galaxy Backbone data centre that the article says serves government and also all corporate entities wanting to provide services to their own clients.

facts.fact: The article describes the Galaxy Backbone data centre in the Abuja National Shared Services Centre (commissioned 20 December 2022) as Uptime Certified Tier III; it does not say which Uptime certification (design, constructed facility or operational).
